stimuli: Constructed byte streams for unit/mechanism tests; never primary capability evidence

modes.A: Only current observed byte(s), all persistent tensors freshly zeroed
modes.B_snapshot: Same frozen 098 with an externally serialized complete state
modes.B_replay: Same frozen 098, zero initial state, external raw history replayed on every query
modes.C: Unmodified 098 with complete native carried state
modes.D: Not executed: no trained predictive-state variant exists in pinned source

prediction_boundary: Model receives only observed byte IDs, legitimate owners/clock and permitted prior state. Labels, future bytes and evaluator material never enter it.
controls: balanced conflicting histories and identical current observation
full reset preserving logical clock plus true fresh-start control
same-clock donor state with metadata preserved
bank-only reset; context-only reset; lexical-only reset; previous-key reset
zero write mask versus full reset
external state save/load and raw replay equivalence
decoder-only parameter perturbation must preserve all updated state
future-only poison, owner isolation, weight identity, fresh-process replay
one future prediction loss gradient through acquired state; detached-state negative control
cost_reporting: CPU FP32 one thread; p50/p95; streaming update, external snapshot transport and full raw-history replay separately. Profiler FLOPs cover supported ATen operations only, not all arithmetic, hardware instructions, energy or production latency.
